title: Discovery of Novel SIK2/3 Inhibitors for the Potential Treatment of MEF2C+ Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML).
authors: Zhu, Wei; Zhao, Pei; Liu, Tingting; Gao, Feng; Li, Qi; Cai, Xin; Zhang, Man; Aliper, Alex; Ren, Feng; Zhavoronkov, Alex; Ding, Xiao
one_liner_zh: 该文聚焦SIK2/3激酶抑制剂发现与AML治疗，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，仅用生成化学平台辅助药物设计，与本课题无关。
abstract: The dual inhibition of SIK2/3 has been considered as a potential treatment approach for MEF2C-high acute myeloid leukemia (AML). Although diverse scaffolds of pan-SIK or SIK2/3 inhibitors have been reported, few of them showed sufficient in vitro or in vivo antitumor activity. Based on the proposed binding mode of the hit molecule (7), chemical space in the solvent/P-loop region was explored via fragment growing/replacement, supported by the generative chemistry platform. Further SAR exploration and ADME optimization led to the discovery of 7s, which exhibited excellent potency and strong selectivity in MEF2C high-expression cell lines over MEF2C-low cell lines. Moreover, oral administration of 7s was found to demonstrate significant tumor growth inhibition in a MV4-11 AML mice CDX model without any body weight loss. This work highlights the potential of targeting MEF2C-dependent AML by selective oral SIK2/3 inhibitors, which was supported by the generative models.
abstract_zh: SIK2/3的双重抑制已被视为针对MEF2C高表达急性髓系白血病（AML）的潜在治疗策略。尽管已有多种骨架的泛SIK或SIK2/3抑制剂被报道，但其中很少有显示出足够的体外或体内抗肿瘤活性。基于命中分子（7）的预测结合模式，通过片段生长/替换探索了溶剂/P-loop区域的化学空间，并借助生成化学平台进行支持。进一步的构效关系（SAR）探索和ADME优化导致了化合物7s的发现，该化合物在MEF2C高表达细胞系中表现出优异的效力和强选择性，相较于MEF2C低表达细胞系。此外，口服给予7s在MV4-11 AML小鼠CDX模型中显示出显著的肿瘤生长抑制，且未出现体重下降。本研究强调了通过选择性口服SIK2/3抑制剂靶向MEF2C依赖性AML的潜力，并得到了生成模型的支持。
